title: REQ · A pure guard helper reports tracked node_modules paths
summary: Add helper that flags node_modules paths in a file list
description: Context: nothing prevents node_modules from being re-tracked. Desired behavior: a pure function trackedNodeModulesPaths(paths) returns every path having a node_modules segment, usable on git ls-files output. Expected result: a guard can fail when vendored files are tracked. Why: prevents regressions of this intent.
acceptance_criteria: Given paths including game/frontend/node_modules/phaser/scripts/tsgen/src/Parser.ts and game/frontend/src/App.tsx, when the helper runs, then only the first is returned
Given a list with no node_modules segment, when the helper runs, then an empty array is returned
technical_constraints: Pure function, no filesystem or git access
